'''Aul''' was one of the seven seasons of [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]]. It was also used as a first name for [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrians]] born during this season, such as [[Aul Tarrus Vishav]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
